Project overview

Altaire Jackson is an eight-story, 207-home affordable housing building with one garage level. The project achieved $4.5 million in savings and was completed three months before the contractual completion date.

The project formed part of my multifamily construction work at SRM. My responsibilities span procurement, project financials, subcontractor coordination, billing, and owner meetings.
